composition: Truncated chalk church on the cliff edge · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: At Højerup, the old chalk church of Stevns Klint stands on the grass at the cliff edge, cut off where the choir fell toward the sea. White chalk drops to the dark Baltic. The night is mainly clear, about 11.4°C, and the cliff path is empty. This is not the beech-lined cliff at Møns Klint, which has no church on the rim.
